retrievalProfile.description: A central bi-color circle anchor with a heavy diagonal typographic banner, surrounded by five vignetted portraits emerging from a dark background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, textured background featuring a central circular graphic divided horizontally into green (top) and red (bottom) halves. A large, white, heavy-stroked typographic banner cuts across the circle at a sharp upward diagonal. Five individual male portraits with 1970s styling are arranged around the perimeter, their shoulders fading into the black void.
coreVisualRelationships: Central geometric anchor vs. peripheral organic portraits
Sharp diagonal movement vs. static circular background
High contrast white text vs. deep black negative space
Symmetrical portrait distribution around a central axis

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five portraits of equal scale distributed in the corners and bottom center, framing the central graphic.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large green and red circle in the center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-left portrait, follows the diagonal text upward to the right, then circles around the peripheral faces.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space that creates a sense of depth and focus on the central elements.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the central graphic contrasts with the naturalistic, warm tones of the skin and blue clothing in the portraits.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy black inner stroke with thick white outer border
Letters are sheared to match a 15-20 degree upward diagonal
Overlapping characters where the tail of one letter merges into the next
characterSpecificRedesigns: The first letter has an elongated vertical stem
The final letter is slightly smaller or tucked into the previous stroke
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy custom display lettering paired with a clean, legible secondary sans-serif for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and blocky structure for the display text.
Suitable for the top-center metadata text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark black textured background. Place a large circle in the center, split horizontally with a green top half and a red bottom half. Arrange five vignetted portraits of men with 70s hairstyles and blue shirts around the circle, fading their shoulders into the black background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold, uppercase title in a diagonal orientation across the center circle. The text should have a heavy white fill and a thick black outline. Add a smaller subtitle in white sans-serif at the top center.

verificationChecks: Is the central circle split horizontally into green and red?
Does the main text sit at a diagonal angle?
Are there five distinct portraits vignetted into the black background?
Is the background solid black with slight texture?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
Original brand logos in the corners
Exact kerning and ligatures of the custom lettering
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the heavy outline.
Check that the portraits do not overlap the central circle significantly.
Verify the green and red colors are vibrant and saturated.
Confirm the diagonal text creates a sense of upward movement.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central [Geometric Shape] + [Bi-color Split] + [Diagonal Heavy Typography] + [Peripheral Vignetted Portraits] + [Black Background]
